faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 made in China?
faqs.a: A Philips technical sheet identifies China as the country of production and Jiangsu Konsung as the manufacturer of Oxygenate 5, model KSW-5. Philips distributes it. Confirm the label and documents for the individual India-sold unit.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 a Konsung KSW-5?
faqs.a: A German medical-device listing identifies Oxygenate 5, product 1156380, as model KSW-5 made by Jiangsu Konsung. Philips distributes Oxygenate 5. Check the label and documentation of an individual unit, since configurations and warranty terms may differ by market.

faqs.q: How much does Oxygenate 5 cost in India?
faqs.a: Indicative India pricing is ₹45,000–₹55,000. Confirm taxes, availability, delivery, setup and accessories before ordering.

faqs.q: What warranty is advertised in India?
faqs.a: Philips India describes a three-year limited device warranty and a 10,000-hour sieve warranty. Ask for the applicable written conditions, exclusions and claim process.

faqs.q: What are the Philips Oxygenate 5 specifications?
faqs.a: Philips India publishes 0.5–5 L/min continuous flow, 93% ±3% oxygen concentration, 18 kg weight, sound below 40 dB(A) under specified conditions, and 230 V / 50 Hz input. The electrical rating is below 360 VA, not a measured wattage.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 the same as Philips EverFlo?
faqs.a: Oxygenate 5 and EverFlo are different model names. Oxygenate 5 is identified as the Konsung-manufactured KSW-5. Do not assume the same components, accessories, warranty or service terms apply to an EverFlo unit; compare the exact model documents.

faqs.q: Is Philips Oxygenate 5 worth the price?
faqs.a: At the indicative ₹45,000–₹55,000 India price, evaluate the exact package, prescribed requirements, applicable warranty and local support. HHZ would not pay extra for the Philips logo alone: the documented manufacturer is Konsung and the model is KSW-5. Any premium should be supported by concrete differences in the offer.

faqs.q: What does Philips branding add to Oxygenate 5?
faqs.a: Philips branding and distribution are documented. Philips India advertises a three-year limited warranty, a 10,000-hour sieve warranty and additional filters. Confirm the terms and service for the actual unit; the badge alone does not prove superior engineering or performance.

faqs.q: Does Chinese manufacture mean Oxygenate 5 is poor quality?
faqs.a: No. Chinese manufacture by itself does not establish poor quality. Judge model-specific evidence, warranty, service and total price. HHZ has not bench-tested this unit or established superiority or inferiority against another KSW-5 configuration.

Philips lists Oxygenate 5 at 18 kg; its EverFlo brochure lists 14 kg. The difference is 4 kg, or about 29%. Assess lifting, door thresholds and vehicle loading before purchase, particularly where a caregiver has limited strength. Weight alone does not identify sieve chemistry.

faqs.q: What should I check about Oxygenate 5 service near me?
faqs.a: Get the responsible service provider, local repair or shipment arrangements, approved PCB/valve/sieve-column availability, turnaround and itemised labour and transport charges in writing. Philips branding alone does not establish model-specific service in your town.
